title: stardust rollout/workspace/mapping.json
description: The source side of every delivered block: per template, its sections and block instances, each with the CSS selector of its origin element in the page's captured source DOM (stardust/current/pages/<slug>.html, read as rollout lib.mjs parseHtml reads it). Written by skills/rollout/scripts/block-origin.mjs from the coverage pages.json, the content documents and the captures. Keys sorted, generatedAt copied from pages.json: unchanged inputs give byte-identical output. Owned by stardust:rollout; strict here because it describes exactly what stardust writes; clients ignore fields they do not know.

formatVersion.description: Mapping format version (semver), versioned like the coverage files: before 1.0.0 a release may still change the shape; from 1.0.0 a minor release only adds fields.

generatedAt.description: The pages.json generatedAt (never the wall clock); null when the coverage has none.

skipped.description: What was not mapped, by slug then record pos: a page (no delivered structure, no content file, no capture, a capture that could not be indexed, a page that could not be mapped) or a coverage block record the delivered document no longer has.

templates.description: One entry per coverage template (templateId, untyped for none) with at least one mapped page, by templateId.

selector.description: A CSS selector over the captured source DOM (tag, *, #id, .class, attribute tests, descendant and > combinators, :nth-of-type, :nth-child, :first/last-child, :first/last-of-type); null when there is no element.

confidence.description: 0 to 1, 3 decimals: the share of the delivered text the element holds; 1 for an encoder map's element, 0 for a position.

block.description: A skipped block record only: its block name.

pos.description: A skipped block record only: its pos in the page's delivered.blocks.

templateId.description: The coverage templateId; untyped for pages without one.

pages.description: Slugs of the mapped pages, sorted.

sections.description: The template's sections aligned across its pages (by style and block names), in order.

blocks.description: One entry per block, variantId and section, by section order then first appearance (representative first).

id.description: s1…sN: the representative's sections in order, then sections other pages add.

selector.description: The generalisation of the section's per-page selector (the lowest common ancestor of its records) that resolved to that page's own section element on the most of its pages; null when no page had an anchor.

pages.description: Sorted slugs where selector's one hit is that page's own section element; --verify may drop a page, never adds one.

style.description: The delivered section style (section-metadata), or null.

blocks.description: The section's block names, unique, in order.

defaultContent.description: Roles of the section's default content: the eds-schema roles of its text, else its delivered default parts (heading, text, image, button, link-list, ...).

confidence.description: The lowest, over its pages, share of the section's text its element holds (0 without one).

variant.description: The coverage record's variant (its classes), or null.

section.description: The id of the section holding it; null only for a record outside every coverage section.

positions.description: The pos values of its instances across its pages (the record's place in each page's delivered.blocks), unique, ascending.

instances.description: One per delivered occurrence, by slug then record pos.

pos.description: The block record's pos in the page's coverage row (delivered.blocks[].pos): with slug, a stable key to the delivered block.

source.description: encoder-map: the template's encoder map selects the element (a marker's k-th match for the k-th block of its name; confidence 1); text-alignment: the element covering most of the block's text; position: placed among its anchored neighbours (confidence 0). A block the map has no element for falls through to text-alignment, then position.

verified.description: With --verify: true when the selector resolves to exactly one element of the capture, else false; null when not verified.
